body: packages/viewer-core/src/theme.tsx exposes useTheme() (throws without ThemeProvider) and useThemeOptional() (returns null). Viewers MUST use the optional variant so they render standalone (playground, future hosts) without crashing. Host writes html[data-theme=mode] + --fv-font-size/line-height/content-width/font-family CSS vars; DEFAULT_THEME = {mode:light, fontSize:16, lineHeight:1.65, contentWidth:760, fontFamily:sans}. Chrome-ext = uncontrolled ThemeProvider; playground = controlled (value+onChange).
title: Viewers read theme via useThemeOptional(), never useTheme()
